title: 第7章 迟来的突破第8章 突变
content_zh:
张皓旸想通这些，三年来自己修为无法寸进的原因就已再清楚不过，一切释然。
此红色石头是父母所赐，他并没有因此而责怪父母，父母也并不知道此块石头会吸收真气，如果知道他们又怎会将石头给他，影响他三年的修行。
正所谓福祸相依，谁又能知道，这块吸收真气的石头会给张皓旸带来什么？真的只是灾祸吗？
内视丹田内的红色石头，张皓旸眼睛湿润，这让他更加想念自己的父母，这毕竟是父母留给他的现存的唯一念想。
又过了盏茶时间，他缓缓坐起平复了一下激动的心情。
张皓旸尝试运转尚武学院学的吐纳功法吸收外界灵气，他打算通过吸收大量灵气转化成更多的真气让这块红色石头吸收，直至红色石头吸收饱和后再说。
只是让张皓旸想不到的是，不管张皓旸如何快速吸收四周的灵气气，当灵气转化成真气的一瞬间就会被红色石头吸收。
就在张皓旸一筹莫展之时，他突然想起脑海中的那段经文。
那段经文是那位白须老者出现后才出现在自己脑海中的，既然如此那就死马当活马医，他不知道经文的真正含义，不知如何运转，干脆就口中直接默念经文，运转尚武学院学的吸纳功法吸收外界灵气。
在张皓旸口中默念40字经文，施展吸纳之法吸收灵气的瞬间，他四周的灵气竟犹如山洪决口般直接涌入他的体内，他体内的经脉仿佛犹如一条乡村小道被千军万马冲击，狂涌而入的灵气瞬间充斥经脉，经脉内壁被瞬间扩充；他干涸的丹田被涌入的磅礴灵气瞬间填满，他的经脉、他的丹田被巨量灵气不停冲刷，他痛苦不已。
张皓旸面部有些扭曲变形，身体都不由自主的颤抖起来，他几近昏厥，但是凭借他不屈的毅力，凭借为父母报仇的强大动力，张皓旸强忍着钻心的经脉撕扯之痛；忍受着丹田犹如万剑穿刺之痛。
张皓旸口中默念的经文未停，进入体内的灵气转化成真气后，竟被经文将其引入身体奇经八脉中，最终汇于丹田，干涸的丹田逐渐充盈。
经过大约两个时辰的真气引导，经脉与丹田已经鼓胀的极其充盈，仿佛下一刻，经脉和丹田就要涨破。
张皓旸炼体四重的瓶颈开始出现丝丝裂缝，在真气的不断冲击之下，裂缝在逐渐变大再变大。
盏茶时间后，就听到张皓旸的身体突然发出“嘭”
的一声闷响，张皓旸三年都未寸进的修为，练体四层的瓶颈在这一刻终于被击碎，他的修为也终于水到渠成踏入练体五层之境。
张皓旸的修为在突破到炼体五层后并没有停止而是继续进行，炼体五层小成、大成、圆满、巅峰、炼体六层小成、大成、圆满巅峰、炼体七层小成、大成、圆满、巅峰，此次突破直到炼体七层巅峰方才最终停止。
伴随着修为突破到炼体七层巅峰，张皓旸的丹田扩大一倍不止，如果说张皓旸原来的丹田有鸡蛋大小，而修为突破后，丹田就已经有鹅蛋大小。
不但如此，他的丹田上还有七彩华光闪烁。
张皓旸在仔细查看后知道他体内的丹田竟是七彩的，发着耀眼的光芒，甚是惊艳，普通人的丹田不会发光，更不会发出七彩之光。

张皓旸仔细感受自己炼体七层巅峰的修为，修为提升后，他之前修炼的武技、功法施展起来威力都有不成程度的提升，若单论力量，他简简单单挥出一拳的力量就足有斤，比炼体四层时足足高出两倍，可见威力之巨大。
感受着自己修为的变化，张皓旸的眼睛竟是有些湿润。
三年来自己的修为没有丝毫提升，尚武学院内同龄的弟子都在嘲笑他，同城的子弟也在耻笑他，都在背后指指点点，说他是假天才，是靠丹药喂起来的天才。
一开始面对这些他也是有些生气、懊恼，后来就慢慢习惯这种指点、这种耻笑。
因为清楚自己的能力，他始终坚信，自己肯定能再回到原先那个状态，甚至能超越原先的状态。
现在看来，三年修为未有提升，如今一朝突破就接连突破三级，由炼体境四层巅峰突破到炼体境七层巅峰，他的天赋、妖孽又回来了。
此时的张皓旸尚不清楚，此时的张皓旸已不是三年前的他所能媲美，他的天赋已经远超三年前的他自己。
现在他的修炼天赋根本不能用异于常人、不能用天才来描述，要用极其妖孽来评价现在的他才更为确切。

content_en:
After Zhang Haoyang thought about this, he became very clear about the reason why he had not been able to improve his cultivation in the past three years, and he felt relieved.
This red stone was given to him by his parents. He did not blame his parents for this. His parents did not know that this stone would absorb the true energy. If they knew, how could they give it to him and affect his three years of practice.
As the saying goes, good fortune and misfortune depend on each other, but who knows what this stone that absorbs true energy will bring to Zhang Haoyang? Is it really just a disaster?
Looking at the red stone in his Dantian, Zhang Haoyang's eyes were moist, which made him miss his parents even more. After all, these were the only thoughts left to him by his parents.
After another cup of tea, he slowly sat up and calmed down his excitement.
Zhang Haoyang tried to use the breathing technique learned at Shangwu Academy to absorb external spiritual energy. He planned to absorb a large amount of spiritual energy and convert it into more true energy for the red stone to absorb until the red stone was saturated.
What Zhang Haoyang didn't expect was that no matter how quickly Zhang Haoyang absorbed the spiritual energy around him, it would be absorbed by the red stone the moment the spiritual energy was transformed into true energy.
Just when Zhang Haoyang was at a loss what to do, he suddenly remembered the passage in his mind.
That scripture only appeared in his mind after the white-bearded old man appeared. In this case, he was a dead horse and a living doctor. He didn't know the true meaning of the scripture and didn't know how to operate it. He simply recited the scripture silently and used the absorption skills learned at Shangwu Academy to absorb external spiritual energy.
The moment Zhang Haoyang silently recited the 40-word scripture and used the method of absorption to absorb the spiritual energy, the spiritual energy around him poured directly into his body like a mountain torrent. The meridians in his body seemed like a country road being destroyed by thousands of troops. The horse struck, and the influx of spiritual energy instantly filled his meridians, and the inner walls of his meridians were instantly expanded; his dry Dantian was instantly filled with the influx of majestic spiritual energy, and his meridians and his Dantian were continuously washed away by the huge amount of spiritual energy, and he was in agony.
Zhang Haoyang's face was a little distorted and his body was shaking involuntarily. He almost fainted. However, with his unyielding perseverance and strong motivation to avenge his parents, Zhang Haoyang endured the heartbreaking pain of tearing his meridians; he endured the pain in his Dantian like the piercing of ten thousand swords.
Zhang Haoyang continued to recite the sutra silently in his mouth. After the spiritual energy entering the body was transformed into true energy, the sutra introduced it into the eight extraordinary meridians of the body, and finally gathered in the Dantian, and the dry Dantian gradually filled up.
After about two hours of directing Qi, the meridians and Dantian have swelled to an extremely full level, as if the meridians and Dantian will burst in the next moment.
Cracks began to appear in the bottleneck of Zhang Haoyang's fourth level of body refining. Under the constant impact of the true energy, the cracks gradually grew bigger and bigger.
After drinking tea, I heard Zhang Haoyang's body suddenly make a "bang"
With a muffled sound, Zhang Haoyang's cultivation, which had not improved even an inch in three years, was finally broken at this moment. His cultivation level finally reached the fifth level.
Zhang Haoyang's cultivation did not stop after breaking through to the fifth level of body refining but continued. The fifth level of body refining was a small success, a great success, and the peak. The sixth level of body refining was a small success, a great success, and the peak of perfection. The seventh level of body refining was a small success, a great success, perfection, and the peak. This breakthrough did not finally stop until the seventh level of body refining was at the peak.
As his cultivation reached the peak of the seventh level of body refining, Zhang Haoyang's Dantian more than doubled in size. If Zhang Haoyang's original Dantian was the size of an egg, after his cultivation breakthrough, his Dantian was already the size of a goose egg.
Not only that, there were colorful lights flashing on his Dantian.
After careful inspection, Zhang Haoyang found out that the Dantian in his body was actually seven-colored, glowing with dazzling light, which was very surprising. Ordinary people's Dantian did not glow, let alone emit colorful light.
Zhang Haoyang carefully felt his cultivation at the seventh level of body training. After his cultivation was improved, the martial arts and exercises he had practiced before were much more powerful.As for the improvement, in terms of strength alone, the force of a simple punch he threw was enough to weigh a kilogram, which was twice as much as when he was at the fourth level of body refining, which shows how powerful he is.
Feeling the changes in his cultivation, Zhang Haoyang's eyes were actually a little moist.
In the past three years, his cultivation has not improved at all. The disciples of the same age in Shangwu Academy are laughing at him, and the children in the same city are also laughing at him. They all point fingers behind his back, saying that he is a fake genius, a genius who was fed by pills.
At first he was a little angry and annoyed when faced with this, but later he gradually got used to this kind of advice and ridicule.
Because he is aware of his abilities, he always firmly believes that he can definitely return to his original state, or even surpass it.
Now it seems that his cultivation level has not improved in three years. Now he breaks through three levels one after another, from the peak of the fourth level of the body refining realm to the peak of the seventh level of the body refining realm. His talent and monster are back.
At this time, Zhang Haoyang still doesn't know that Zhang Haoyang at this time is no longer comparable to what he was three years ago, and his talent has far exceeded his own three years ago.
Now his cultivation talent cannot be described as being different from ordinary people or as a genius. It would be more accurate to evaluate him as an extremely monster.
